vocabulary.meaning: a person or group of people living together in the same home
examples: Household is an important idea when discussing families.
Learning about household can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: a family consisting mainly of parents and their children
examples: People often have different views about nuclear family when discussing families.
Understanding nuclear family can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a family group that includes relatives beyond parents and children
examples: The topic of families raises useful questions about extended family.
We can discuss how extended family affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: the way a child is raised and educated by family or caregivers
examples: Upbringing can play an important role in debates about families.
Different countries may deal with upbringing in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the way two or more people are connected and interact
examples: A discussion about families can include the effects of relationship.
Knowing the meaning of relationship makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a group of people born and living around the same period
examples: Generation is useful vocabulary for talking about families.
We can use the idea of generation to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
